newsitem.title: USA: Republic Industries to buy 2 auto dealers.
newsitem.headline: Republic Industries to buy 2 auto dealers.

text.p: Republic Industries Inc., led by Florida billionaire Wayne Huizenga, said Wednesday it agreed to buy major auto dealerships in Denver and Dallas for about $104 million in stock.

Republic, based in Fort Lauderdale, has been aggressively buying auto dealers to create a national network. It also has operations in garbage and waste hauling, electronic security services and the rental car business.

Republic said it would acquire Chesrown Automotive Group, which owns and operates Chevrolet, Geo, Ford, Kia, Dodge, Lincoln-Mercury and Mazda dealerships in Denver and Boulder, Colo., and surrounding areas.
It also will acquire Bankston Enterprises, an owner and operator of Lincoln-Mercury, Saab, Ford, and Nissan dealerships in the Dallas area.
Republic stock fell 6 cents to $35.625 in morning trading on Nasdaq.
